'''Jaaxine R'nar''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] living on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], where he sold [[Starship/Legends|starship]] components inside Coruscant spaceport.
